matches.rationale: Finding 4 notes a dataset size inconsistency but computes an expected larger number (98,400) versus the reported ~52,800, whereas the ground truth claims the size was inflated by roughly doubling. The direction and nature of the mismatch differ, and the locations (Abstract vs. dataset construction) are not equivalent, so no match.
No finding addresses the swapped query matrices in cross-attention (Section 4.3.1). The findings do not mention this conceptual inconsistency, so it remains undetected.

Finding 5 explicitly identifies the asymmetric pre-enhancement protocol used in Table 2, which unfairly benefits the proposed method. Findings 6 (missing methodology for that pre-enhancement) and 7 (distorted conclusion drawn from the unbalanced comparison) both stem from the same core issue of an unfair evaluation protocol. All three capture the identical scientific problem.
No finding points to the exaggerated claim in the introduction that the method excels without acknowledging limitations. The available findings do not cover this claim distortion.
No finding detects the fabricated reference [8] AutoDIR. The citation errors found (pred_ids 2 and 3) involve different references and do not match this fabrication.
No finding mentions the absence of ethical or transparency considerations in the conclusion. This omission is not identified by any predicted finding.
No finding addresses the promotional tone and exaggerated performance claims in the abstract. The existing findings do not identify this rhetorical manipulation.
No finding comments on the missing code availability or the inconsistency between the abstract's GitHub claim and later sections. This misalignment is not captured.
No finding discusses the ambiguity of whether loss functions are applied symmetrically across modalities. This methodological gap is not detected.
No finding mentions the small batch size (12) and patch size (224×224) or questions training robustness. This protocol issue is not identified.
No finding points out the selective framing of results where some metrics are surpassed or matched by competitors. The overstatement of dominance is not detected.
No finding identifies the overly optimistic discussion framing that neglects limitations of the degradation model. This rhetorical issue is not caught.
No finding addresses the 2025-dated references [38] and [43] that are beyond the paper's cutoff or unverifiable. This fabricated temporal validity is not detected.
No finding mentions the absence of ethical considerations regarding privacy or safety-critical use of the datasets. This omission is not identified.

No finding points out the inconsistency between the text claiming best performance on CLIP-IQA, TReS, SD and the Table 3 MUSIQ result where Text-DiFuse outperforms. This selective interpretation is not detected.
